transcript.text: Now, in this guide, I'm explaining how to fly in RuneScape Dragon Wilds. Leave a like and subscribe if you find this
helpful and want to stay up-to-date on all things RuneScape Dragon Wilds. So, if you came across several spots where
you just can't reach it, that's because you need the wind step ability to fly up
to that spot. To do this, you would need to level up room crafting until level eight. After doing that, use air runes
crafted at the rune altar to use the wind step ability. When activated, when you jump, you will fly for a short
period of time, allowing you to get to those hard-to-reach spaces. When using this, make sure you have enough runes to
get back from high ledges or spots that have death pits near them. And that'll do it for this guide. Comment below if
you have any questions, and I will try to help.
